FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CoolHeat Solutions specializes in providing comprehensive heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) services for both residential and small commercial clients. Our operations focus on the installation, maintenance, and repair of HVAC systems, ensuring optimal performance and energy efficiency. We employ certified and licensed technicians who adhere to strict safety standards and regulations, including ongoing training and development programs. Our commitment to quality is demonstrated through our written preventive maintenance protocols, which aim to reduce system failures and emergency service calls. We prioritize customer satisfaction and utilize digital scheduling tools to streamline service delivery, ensuring timely responses to client needs. Moreover, we maintain compliance with all relevant environmental regulations to safeguard our clients and the community.
